FM03.reasoning: The agent proceeds directly to feature extraction and modeling without any steps to check for or handle missing values, duplicates, or outliers.

FM15.reasoning: The agent only uses log loss to evaluate the models and optimize weights, without checking other metrics like accuracy or AUC to verify performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Data-Dependent Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent dynamically identifies binary vs. continuous columns based on the specific values present in the dataset (checking if all values are 0 or 1). Because this is applied independently to the train and test sets, any slight distribution difference (e.g., a rare continuous feature happening to only have 0s and 1s in the test set) will lead to mismatched feature sets, misaligned columns, and potential runtime errors during inference.

other_failure_modes.name: Degenerate Self-Attention
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies MultiheadAttention to a sequence of length 1 by unsqueezing the entire feature vector into a single token. For a sequence of length 1, attention weights mathematically evaluate to exactly 1.0, reducing the complex transformer block to a simple linear projection and entirely defeating the purpose of using self-attention.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
x_seq = x.unsqueeze(1)
attn_out, _ = self.attn(x_seq, x_seq, x_seq)

other_failure_modes.name: Dead Code / Unused Transformations
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes transformations (QuantileTransformer) for all folds but never includes the resulting arrays in the final feature set used for modeling, wasting computation and indicating a logical oversight.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
qt = QuantileTransformer(...)
X_tr_qt = qt.fit_transform(X_tr_vt)

summary: The agent builds a robust 5-fold cross-validation pipeline with multiple models and an SLSQP-optimized ensemble. However, it completely skips basic data cleaning and relies exclusively on a single evaluation metric. More critically, there are significant logical flaws in the solution: the dynamic feature engineering risks creating mismatched train/test schemas, and the custom neural network architecture misuses self-attention in a way that renders it mathematically degenerate.
